caption: A sock is pulled over a foot, the opening stretching as the fabric is drawn up over the heel and ankle.

sa.check: A sock is pulled over a foot.
The fabric is drawn up over the heel and ankle.
The opening stretches first and the fabric is drawn up after.

pc.expect: The foot goes into the opening, not through the fabric.
pc.fail: It goes through the fabric; or the sock passes through the foot; or the hands pass through.

pc.expect: The sock stretches around the foot and follows its shape.
pc.fail: It does not stretch; or grows huge; or the foot changes shape.
It is rigid; or tears; or melts.

pc.expect: It moves only as it is pulled.
pc.fail: It climbs by itself; or slides off; or jumps.

pc.expect: One sock and one foot keep their number.
pc.fail: The sock duplicates; or the foot detaches; or they merge.

pc.expect: The sock's colour and the background stay the same.
pc.fail: The sock changes colour; or the foot changes; or the background rearranges.
